paper_trading_starts: 2026-11-30 (orders after the 27 Nov close; first open after the amendment)
signal_definition: mean of rank z-scores of close(t-21)/close(t-252)-1 and the 60-day mean delivery %, over the frozen universe mask
rules: no retraining or re-tuning during the paper-trading period

results are scored with the same cost and tax engine as the backtests
comparison: paper_mom_10L, paper_10L, the null control and the Nifty 50; kill review if more than 15 points behind paper_mom_10L after 6 months
